subject: MentorMix kickoff — noise-robust training for Corpus users
body:
Team,

Kicking off the MentorMix integration. Why it matters: methods that look great on synthetic label noise often fall over on real-world noise; our MentorMix work — combining MentorNet-style curriculum weighting with Mixup, in the four-step weight/sample/mixup loop — holds up on both, and we also have the first controlled benchmark of real-world web label noise to prove it. Corpus ingestion produces exactly this kind of noisy data, so a blessed noise-robust trainer is a natural platform feature.

Milestones (window through 06-15):
- 04-03: MentorMix reference implementation reproducing published numbers on the controlled-noise benchmark.
- 05-08: trainer integrated behind a Corpus platform API with noise-level presets.
- 06-05: pilot with one internal team on genuinely noisy ingested data.

Bruno owns staffing; Ondrej is TL. Note we should sequence carefully around the Corpus v2 migration — Bruno, please align with Jun's team on timing.

Dmitri
